top_signals.title: Why bond investors are pushing up some of your interest rates
top_signals.summary: Many types of consumer loans such as mortgages peg their interest rate to the yield on 10-year Treasury bonds, which has been moving higher.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: The ‘Trump Trade’ Is Turning Into a Loser in the Stock Market
top_signals.summary: When Donald Trump was elected to a second term as president, amateur and professional traders alike rushed to identify which stocks would benefit from his aggressive economic policies.
